# PageSkeleton

Page skeleton: replaces the whole page while its data loads for the first time; its shape is close to the final
page, which reduces layout shifts.

**Interaction**: stays invisible after mounting and fades in after 200 ms, so loads that finish quickly do not
flash a skeleton; together with useDelayedPending, a skeleton that has appeared stays for at least 400 ms:
`if (query.isPending || showSkeleton) return <PageSkeleton />`. Not interactive.

**Category**: Feedback · **Common uses**: First load of list pages, detail pages and split view pages

## Import

```ts
import { PageSkeleton } from 'vellum-ui'
```

## Basic usage

First load of a list page. It stays invisible after mounting and fades in after 200 ms, so fast loads do not
flash a skeleton.

```tsx
export function Basic() {
  return <PageSkeleton />
}
```

## Variants

### Split view page

```tsx
export function Split() {
  return <PageSkeleton variant="split" />
}
```

## Advanced

### No flash: shown for at least 400 ms

useDelayedPending keeps the skeleton visible for at least 400 ms once it appears, so slightly slow loads do not
flash by.
On first load, include `isPending` in the condition as well: the skeleton mounts as soon as loading starts, and
its own 200 ms delayed fade-in works together with the hook.

```tsx
export function WithDelayedPending() {
  const [pending, setPending] = useState(false)
  const showSkeleton = useDelayedPending(pending)
  const load = (ms: number) => {
    setPending(true)
    setTimeout(() => setPending(false), ms)
  }
  return (
    <Stack gap={4}>
      <Inline>
        <Button onClick={() => load(150)}>Load in 150 ms</Button>
        <Button onClick={() => load(300)}>Load in 300 ms</Button>
        <Button onClick={() => load(1500)}>Load in 1.5 s</Button>
      </Inline>
      {pending || showSkeleton ? <PageSkeleton /> : <Text>Content loaded</Text>}
    </Stack>
  )
}
```

## Props

| Prop | Type | Description | Default | Required |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `variant` | `'list' \| 'detail' \| 'split'` | Shape of the skeleton: `list` for list pages (title + list or table); `detail` for detail pages (title + blocks of information); `split` for split view pages (list or navigation on the left + content on the right). | `'list'` | No |
| `immediate` | `boolean` | Shows the skeleton immediately, without the 200 ms delayed appearance. Only use it when the skeleton is controlled by useDelayedPending and mounted only while that is true, so the delay is not applied twice. | — | No |

Also accepts `testId` (rendered as `data-testid`), `aria-label`, `role` and `id`, like all primitives.

Does not accept `style` or `className`: appearance is adjusted only through the semantic props above and the theme.
